offering_description.value: Supplies and delivers electricity, natural gas and district steam to homes, businesses and public institutions. Also invests in energy transmission infrastructure.

Commercial buildings, industrial businesses, private institutions and energy market participants
Government buildings, public institutions and municipal facilities

Recurring utility customer charges and connection-related services

Delivers purchased electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial and public customers
